summary_en: Correction to earnings forecast disclosed Aug 3, 2026. Net income guidance raised by ¥3,099M (56.3% increase). EPS revised upward to ¥119.30 (consolidated). Dividend forecast adjustment referenced but specific new dividend rate not stated in excerpt.
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Correction of "Notice Regarding Recording of Extraordinary Profit from Sale of Investment Securities, Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)"
translation_en_brief: On August 5, 2026, Toukei Computer Co., Ltd. issued a correction notice to its August 3, 2026 disclosure titled "Notice Regarding Recording of Extraordinary Profit from Sale of Investment Securities, Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)." The correction addresses an error in the "Earnings Per Share" line item within the "Revision of Earnings Forecast" section. The company revised consolidated full-year net income attributable to parent company shareholders upward by ¥3,099 million (56.3% increase) to ¥8,601 million for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. Consolidated EPS was corrected to ¥119.30 (revised from an erroneous prior figure of ¥153.08 in the initial forecast), and individual business EPS was revised to ¥119.15. The revision reflects anticipated extraordinary gains from the sale of investment securities. Dividend forecast modifications were also referenced as part of the original August 3 announcement, though the specific new dividend amount is not detailed in the provided excerpt.
